text:
sara: Follow-up from GPU capacity postmortem. Need concrete owners + small deadlines for quota rules, scheduler experiments, headroom runbook, and alert automation. Keep it lightweight.

miguel: I'll do quota rules: per-customer burst caps + short credit buffer. Draft spec by Mon.

kevin: I'll run 2 quick scheduler experiments in staging (memory bin-packing + affinity). Results by Wed.

ashley: I'll author a concise headroom runbook (what to do at 20%/10%/5%) and add the auto-rollout block. Draft by Thu.

dmitri: I'll wire an ops-bot check: daily spare_gpu snapshot + create REM ticket if spare < 15% twice in a row. Protype alert by next Mon.

sara: Good. Quick decisions: auto-rollouts disabled under 25% spare, dedicated customers flagged as exempt, 48h spike test after remediation. I'll open three REM tickets and tag owners.

ops-bot: jira-created: REM-8001 assigned-to: miguel, REM-8002 assigned-to: kevin, REM-8003 assigned-to: ashley. Reminder scheduled: "Headroom weekly sync" every Mon 09:30.

sara: Thanks team — we'll verify the staging numbers and then merge the runbook. Close this thread once REM tickets have linked PRs and the ops-bot prototype is running.

kevin: Will post the staging run logs here when done.

miguel: On it.

ashley: Adding comms templates to the runbook before PR.

dmitri: Prototype alert job posted to #eng-sre in staging.

sara: Closing loop for now.
